description.value:
Cybertech engineers pour their genius into a single wristpad, turning what other engineers treat as a convenience item into the beating heart of their techcasting. Every circuit is tuned to squeeze more power, more precision, and more flexibility out of the powers they already know.

Their real gift is conversion: aptitude becomes tech points, tech points become aptitude, and a rival's own spell can be captured mid-cast and turned into ammunition. In their hands, a wristpad stops being a tool and becomes a second spellbook, always a subroutine away from doing something new.
